help.title: Help center
help.subtitle: Frequently asked questions, guides and contact
help.contact_desc: Didn't find the answer to your question? Write to support — we usually reply within 1 business day.
help.q_enroll: How do I enroll in a course?
help.a_enroll: Go to «Course catalog», pick a course and click «Enroll». It will appear in «My learning».
help.q_certificate: How do I get a certificate?
help.a_certificate: A certificate is issued automatically once you complete a course 100%. You can download it as a PDF in the «Certificates» section.
help.q_exam: How do I take an exam?
help.a_exam: In «Exams», select an active exam and click «Start» from the lobby. Your result is shown when you finish or time runs out.
help.q_live: How do I join a live class?
help.a_live: In «Live classes», the «Join» button becomes active at the scheduled time. Allow microphone and camera access.
help.a_badge: Each badge is tied to a specific action (lesson, course, exam, activity). The «Achievements» section shows each badge's condition and your progress.
help.q_password: How do I change my password?
help.a_password: Open the profile menu in the top-right corner, go to «Security» and update your password.
